# crosswork_role_catalog (Data Source)

This data source fetches all APIs and tasks that a role can be granted on the Crosswork cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_role_catalog" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `apis` (Attributes Set) List of APIs on the Crosswork cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apis))
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `task_api_permissions` (Attributes Set) List of APIs that tasks need. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--task_api_permissions))
- `tasks` (Attributes Set) List of tasks on the Crosswork cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--apis"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apis`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) API category
- `id` (String) API id
- `name` (String) API name


<a id="nestedatt--task_api_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `task_api_permissions`

Read-Only:

- `access` (String) Access level, such as `R` or `RW`
- `api_id` (String) API id
- `task_id` (String) Task id


<a id="nestedatt--tasks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tasks`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Task category
- `id` (String) Task id
